title: MOCK: Cedar document processing evaluation
content: FICTIONAL TEST DATA. Cedar costs 12 credits per 1,000 pages, supports PDF and text, processes 80 pages per minute, and retains uploaded documents for 7 days. This is a bundled fixture, not a real product or live web result.

title: MOCK: Maple document processing evaluation
